Questions About Generative AI Development

children: What are generative AI development services?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-74bd046 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: The design, engineering, and deployment of systems that create text, images, summaries, and other outputs from business data and user input.
How is generative AI different from traditional AI?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-2917d6e e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Traditional AI classifies and predicts. Generative AI creates. Text, images, summaries, and decisions are produced from learned patterns and supplied context. That difference determines how the system is designed and governed.
How does generative AI work?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-df71506 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Deep learning models trained on large datasets recognise patterns and produce new content. In business applications, they are connected to private data, APIs, and retrieval systems to ground outputs in accurate and relevant information.
What generative AI applications can you build?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-dbc0ba6 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Knowledge assistants, document intelligence systems, content generation platforms, customer support tools, embedded copilots, image generation workflows, and generative AI SaaS products.
What is RAG in generative AI development?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-31f046d e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: RAG connects a model to your approved documents, databases, or knowledge sources so responses are grounded in your data rather than general model knowledge.
Can generative AI connect with our existing software?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-d951992 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. It integrates with CRM, ERP, CMS, SaaS platforms, databases, and internal APIs without replacing existing systems. Integration architecture is defined in Discovery before development begins.
Do you use proprietary or open-source models?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-574c00f e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Both. Model selection depends on privacy, accuracy, latency, context length, and operating cost. We evaluate options in Discovery based on your specific requirements.
How do you improve accuracy in generative AI systems?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-0a4c208 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Grounded retrieval, structured prompts, output validation, source attribution, and human review, where the risk justifies it.
How do you address ethical issues in generative AI?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-9e1a999 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Through moderation pipelines, bias testing, audit logs, human approval steps, and clear governance rules for how data and generated content are used.
How much does generative AI development cost?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-63f04ba e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: A focused RAG system or generative AI feature starts from $20K. A full platform with complex integrations typically ranges from $80K to $250K. The precise number is defined in the Discovery Sprint.
